tEn: Xiaomi-Robotics-1: Scaling Vision-Language-Action Models with over 100K Hours of Real-World Trajectories
tZh: 小米机器人-1：基于超过10万小时真实世界轨迹的视觉-语言-动作模型缩放
sEn: Xiaomi-Robotics-1 is a VLA model pre-trained on 100K hours of real-world trajectories and post-trained for efficient adaptation, achieving state-of-the-art results on multiple benchmarks.
sZh: 小米机器人-1是在10万小时真实世界轨迹上预训练的VLA模型，通过后训练实现高效适应，在多个基准上达到最优。
absEn: We present Xiaomi-Robotics-1, a foundational vision-language-action (VLA) model capable of (1) following diverse language instructions to perform a wide range of mobile manipulation tasks in unseen environments out-of-the-box, and (2) efficiently adapting to novel downstream tasks with minimal fine-tuning data. We propose a two-stage training recipe consisting of pre-training and post-training. During pre-training, we imbue the model with broad and generalizable action-generation capabilities by training on over 100k hours of real-world manipulation trajectories collected via UMI devices. Crucially, we develop a scalable auto-labeling pipeline that annotates trajectory clips with natural languages describing scene state transitions, providing rich and precise conditioning for action learning. During post-training, we aim to align these capabilities with robot embodiments and imperative instructions that humans naturally use to prompt robots. Extensive experiments demonstrate strong scaling behavior. Xiaomi-Robotics-1 consistently improves with increased data scales and model sizes during pre-training. This scaling behavior directly transfers to post-training, where a stronger pre-training model yields better out-of-the-box real-robot performance in unseen environments. Furthermore, Xiaomi-Robotics-1 serves as a strong robot foundation policy that can be efficiently fine-tuned on complex, dexterous tasks with high data efficiency. Across multiple simulation benchmarks, Xiaomi-Robotics-1 outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Notably, it establishes a new state-of-the-art with a 57.4% success rate on RoboCasa365, surpassing the previous best of 46.6%. Furthermore, it achieves an average score of 20.07 on RoboDojo, significantly outperforming the prior state-of-the-art (13.07). Code and model checkpoints will be released. Project page: https://robotics.xiaomi.com/xiaomi-robotics-1.html
absZh: 我们提出小米机器人-1，这是一个基础的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，能够（1）遵循多样的语言指令，在未见环境中开箱即用地执行广泛的移动操作任务，以及（2）通过极少的微调数据高效适应新的下游任务。我们提出一个两阶段训练方案，包括预训练和后训练。在预训练期间，我们通过在超过10万小时的通过UMI设备收集的真实操作轨迹上训练，赋予模型广泛且可泛化的动作生成能力。关键的是，我们开发了一个可扩展的自动标注流程，用描述场景状态转换的自然语言来标注轨迹片段，为动作学习提供丰富且精确的条件。在后训练期间，我们旨在将这些能力与机器人实体和人类自然用于提示机器人的指令性指令对齐。大量实验展示了强大的缩放行为。小米机器人-1在预训练期间随着数据规模和模型大小的增加而持续改进。这种缩放行为直接转移到后训练中，更强的预训练模型在未见环境中产生更好的开箱即用真实机器人性能。此外，小米机器人-1作为一个强大的机器人基础策略，可以以高数据效率有效地微调复杂的、灵巧的任务。在多个模拟基准上，小米机器人-1优于最先进的方法。值得注意的是，它在RoboCasa365上建立了新的最先进水平，成功率为57.4%，超过了之前的最高46.6%。此外，它在RoboDojo上获得了20.07的平均分，显著优于先前的最先进水平（13.07）。代码和模型检查点将发布。项目页面：https://robotics.xiaomi.com/xiaomi-robotics-1.html

items.en: We present Xiaomi-Robotics-1, a foundational vision-language-action (VLA) model capable of (1) following diverse language instructions to perform a wide range of mobile manipulation tasks in unseen environments out-of-the-box, and (2) efficiently adapting to novel downstream tasks with minimal fine-tuning data. We propose a two-stage training recipe consisting of pre-training and post-training. During pre-training, we imbue the model with broad and generalizable action-generation capabilities by training on over 100k hours of real-world manipulation trajectories, collected via UMI devices across a massive scale of environments and tasks. Crucially, we develop a scalable auto-labeling pipeline that annotates trajectory clips with natural languages describing scene state transitions, providing rich and precise conditioning for action learning. During post-training, we aim to align these capabilities with robot embodiments and imperative task instructions that humans naturally use to prompt robots, effectively mapping descriptive state transition understanding into actionable task prompts. Extensive experiments demonstrate strong scaling behavior. Xiaomi-Robotics-1 consistently improves with increased data scales and model sizes during pre-training. This scaling behavior directly transfers to post-training, where a stronger pre-training model yields better out-of-the-box performance in real-robot evaluations within unseen environments. Furthermore, Xiaomi-Robotics-1 serves as a strong robot foundation policy that can be efficiently fine-tuned on complex, dexterous tasks with high data efficiency. Across multiple simulation benchmarks, Xiaomi-Robotics-1 outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Notably, it establishes a new state-of-the-art with a 57.4% success rate on RoboCasa365, surpassing the previous best of 46.6%. Furthermore, it achieves an average score of 20.07 on RoboDojo, significantly outperforming the prior state-of-the-art (13.07). Code and model checkpoints will be released. Project page: https://robotics.xiaomi.com/xiaomi-robotics-1.html

items.en: The remarkable capabilities of modern large models are fundamentally driven by scale, where massive and diverse training corpora have underpinned unprecedented leaps in performance for both large language models and vision-language models. Recent work on vision-language-action (VLA) models and world-action models (WAM) has produced increasingly promising results in robot manipulation, with early evidence that policies become more capable and generalizable as the training data grows in scale and diversity. Following the same scaling trajectory of large models is therefore a natural and appealing direction for robotics. However, robotics is hindered by a unique bottleneck of data. The dominant data collection paradigm, real-robot teleoperation, is slow, costly, and hardware-bound, making it difficult to scale. Furthermore, teleoperated data tends to be highly redundant, concentrated on a narrow slice of tasks and environments, limiting the diversity of the data.
items.zh: 现代大型模型的卓越能力根本上由规模驱动，大规模且多样化的训练语料库支撑了大型语言模型和视觉-语言模型性能的前所未有的飞跃。近期关于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型和世界-动作模型（WAM）的工作在机器人操作中取得了日益令人鼓舞的结果，早期证据表明，随着训练数据在规模和多样性上的增长，策略变得更具能力且更可泛化。因此，遵循大型模型的相同规模扩张轨迹是机器人学的自然且有吸引力的方向。然而，机器人学受到数据这一独特瓶颈的阻碍。主导的数据收集范式——真实机器人遥操作——缓慢、昂贵且受硬件限制，难以扩展。此外，遥操作数据往往高度冗余，集中于狭窄的任务和环境切片，限制了数据的多样性。

items.en: We present Xiaomi-Robotics-1 (Fig. 1), a foundational vision-language-action (VLA) model trained on a massive scale of real-world manipulation trajectories. Drawing inspiration from the training paradigms of large language models, we propose a two-stage training recipe comprising pre-training and post-training. During pre-training, we endow the model with robust and generalizable action-generation capabilities by leveraging data sources that scale readily in both volume and diversity. Specifically, we curate a dataset of over 100k hours of real-world manipulation trajectories with UMI devices, spanning a wide range of environments and tasks. Traditional trajectory labeling typically requires manual segmentation by task semantics and language annotations—a labor-intensive process that becomes prohibitive at this scale. To address this challenge, we develop a scalable auto-labeling pipeline that leverages a pre-trained vision-language model (VLM) to annotate fixed-length trajectory segments with language descriptions detailing scene state transitions. These annotations provide precise and sufficient semantic supervision. Trained on these data, the model learns to generate actions that transform the scene from its current state to the language-specified target state (Fig. 6). In the post-training phase, we utilize over 10k hours of cross-embodiment data to align the strong action-generation capabilities acquired during pre-training. This stage bridges two gaps: adapting the model from generating actions for UMI grippers to actions for robot embodiments, and transitioning from state-transition prompts to imperative instructions typically used by humans to prompt robots. After post-training, Xiaomi-Robotics-1 is able to follow instructions and perform a wide range of tasks in unseen environments. Furthermore, it serves as a strong robot foundation policy that can be efficiently fine-tuned to learn new tasks.
items.zh: 我们提出小米机器人基础模型1（Xiaomi-Robotics-1，图1），这是一个基础的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，在大规模真实世界操作轨迹上训练。受大型语言模型训练范式的启发，我们提出一个两阶段训练方案，包括预训练和后训练。在预训练阶段，我们通过利用在数量和多样性上易于扩展的数据源，赋予模型稳健且可泛化的动作生成能力。具体来说，我们整理了超过10万小时使用UMI设备采集的真实世界操作轨迹数据集，涵盖广泛的环境和任务。传统轨迹标注通常需要按任务语义手动分割和语言注释——这是一个劳动密集型过程，在此规模下变得不可行。为应对此挑战，我们开发了一个可扩展的自动标注流程，利用预训练的视觉-语言模型（VLM）为固定长度的轨迹片段注释描述场景状态变化的语言描述。这些标注提供了精确且充分的语义监督。在这些数据上训练后，模型学会生成将场景从当前状态转换为语言指定目标状态的动作（图6）。在后训练阶段，我们利用超过1万小时的跨具身数据来对齐预训练中获得的强大动作生成能力。这一阶段弥合了两个差距：将模型从为UMI夹爪生成动作适配到为机器人具身生成动作，以及从状态转换提示过渡到人类通常用于提示机器人的命令式指令。后训练后，Xiaomi-Robotics-1能够遵循指令并在未见环境中执行广泛的任务。此外，它作为一个强大的机器人基础策略，可以高效微调以学习新任务。

items.en: We perform extensive experiments to study the scaling properties of Xiaomi-Robotics-1. Results show that Xiaomi-Robotics-1 scales effectively during the pre-training phase, achieving lower validation action errors as data and model scale up. Moreover, the scaling behavior observed in pre-training directly transfers to post-training, where stronger pre-training models yield better post-training success rates in out-of-the-box real-robot evaluation in unseen environments. These results are encouraging, as they indicate that we are able to continue improving performance as we further scale data and model size. In addition, we fine-tune the model on multiple complex dexterous tasks with minimal data. Xiaomi-Robotics-1 achieves an average success rate of 75% across four challenging tasks given less than 10 hours of data per task on average, outperforming \( \pi_{0.5} \) which obtains 40%. In addition, we evaluate Xiaomi-Robotics-1 on four challenging simulation benchmarks, i.e., RoboCasa, RoboCasa365, VLABench, and RoboDojo. Xiaomi-Robotics-1 achieves state-of-the-art results across all four benchmarks. Notably, it sets a new state-of-the-art with a 57.6% success rate on RoboCasa365, a substantial leap from the previous best of 46.6%. On RoboDojo, it delivers an average score of 20.07, significantly outperforming the prior state-of-the-art of 13.07. Finally, Xiaomi-Robotics-1 enables the robot to autonomously accomplish a long-horizon, room-level mobile manipulation task of suitcase packing that spans over 10 minutes (see the project page for the video). Code and model checkpoints will be released. Project page: https://robotics.xiaomi.com/xiaomi-robotics-1.html
items.zh: 我们进行广泛实验研究Xiaomi-Robotics-1的缩放性质。结果表明，Xiaomi-Robotics-1在预训练阶段有效缩放，随着数据和模型规模增大，验证动作误差降低。此外，预训练中观察到的缩放行为直接迁移到后训练，更强的预训练模型在未见环境的开箱即用真实机器人评估中产生更高的后训练成功率。这些结果令人鼓舞，因为它们表明我们能够通过进一步扩大数据和模型规模来持续改进性能。此外，我们在多个复杂的灵巧任务上使用最少数据对模型进行微调。Xiaomi-Robotics-1在四个具有挑战性的任务上平均成功率75%，每个任务平均使用不到10小时数据，优于获得40%成功率的\( \pi_{0.5} \)。此外，我们在四个具有挑战性的模拟基准上评估Xiaomi-Robotics-1，即RoboCasa、RoboCasa365、VLABench和RoboDojo。Xiaomi-Robotics-1在所有四个基准上均取得最先进的结果。值得注意的是，它在RoboCasa365上以57.6%的成功率创下新纪录，较之前最佳的46.6%有大幅提升。在RoboDojo上，它取得了20.07的平均得分，显著优于之前最先进的13.07。最后，Xiaomi-Robotics-1使机器人能够自主完成一个超10分钟的长时程、房间级移动操作任务——行李箱打包（视频请见项目页面）。代码和模型检查点将发布。项目页面：https://robotics.xiaomi.com/xiaomi-robotics-1.html

items.en: We adopt a two-stage training recipe consisting of pre-training and post-training. Pre-training leverages a scalable non-robot dataset with rich open-world diversity to endow the model with broad and generalizable representations for action generation. Post-training then aligns these representations to robot embodiments and instruction-conditioned action generation, using a high-quality set of cross-embodiment data. In the following sections, we describe the details of model architecture, data curation, and training recipe.
items.zh: 我们采用两阶段训练方案，包括预训练和后训练。预训练利用可扩展的非机器人数据集，具有丰富的开放世界多样性，赋予模型广泛且可泛化的表示以生成动作。后训练则将这些表示与机器人本体以及条件于指令的动作生成对齐，使用高质量跨本体数据集。在以下章节中，我们描述模型架构、数据整理和训练方案的细节。

items.capEn: Figure 2: Model Architecture. Xiaomi-Robotics-1 adopts a Mixture-of-Transformers [44] architecture that couples a pre-trained VLM with a DiT. The VLM encodes the observation and language instruction, and additionally predicts action chunks via Choice Policies [59] to accelerate training convergence.

During inference, we initialize the predicted action chunk from a random noise \(\mathbf{a}^{\tau=0}_{t:t+H}\sim\mathcal{N}(\mathbf{0},I)\). The clean action chunk is recovered via a 5-step Euler integration, \(\mathbf{a}^{\tau+\Delta\tau}_{t:t+H}=\mathbf{a}^{\tau}_{t:t+H}+\Delta\tau\cdot\mathbf{v}_{\theta}(\mathbf{o}_{t},l,\mathbf{s}_{t},\mathbf{a}_{t:t+H}^{\tau},\tau)\), where the step size is set to \(\Delta\tau=0.2\).
items.zh: 类似于，我们利用自适应归一化层（adaLN）将流匹配时间步条件注入DiT以生成动作。在推理期间，我们从随机噪声\(\mathbf{a}^{\tau=0}_{t:t+H}\sim\mathcal{N}(\mathbf{0},I)\)初始化预测的动作块。通过5步欧拉积分恢复清洁动作块，\(\mathbf{a}^{\tau+\Delta\tau}_{t:t+H}=\mathbf{a}^{\tau}_{t:t+H}+\Delta\tau\cdot\mathbf{v}_{\theta}(\mathbf{o}_{t},l,\mathbf{s}_{t},\mathbf{a}_{t:t+H}^{\tau},\tau)\)，其中步长设为\(\Delta\tau=0.2\)。

items.en: To accelerate convergence, we introduce an auxiliary action-generation supervision on the VLM. Specifically, we leverage Choice Policies to enable action generation directly within the VLM framework. We encode the robot state into a token using a multi-layer perceptron (MLP) and append it, along with the action and score query tokens, to the end of the vision-language token sequence. The outputs corresponding to the action and score query tokens predict \(K\) candidate action chunks and their associated \(K\) scores, respectively. We adopt a winner-takes-all paradigm as in, where only the candidate with the smallest \(L_{1}\) loss is included in action loss computation:
items.zh: 为了加速收敛，我们引入在VLM上的辅助动作生成监督。具体地，我们利用选择策略（Choice Policies）使得动作生成直接在VLM框架内进行。我们使用多层感知机（MLP）将机器人状态编码为一个token，并将其与动作和分数查询tokens一起附加到视觉语言token序列的末尾。动作和分数查询tokens对应的输出分别预测\(K\)个候选动作块及其相关的\(K\)个分数。我们采用赢家通吃范式，如中所示，其中只有具有最小\(L_{1}\)损失的候选者被包含在动作损失计算中：

items.en: Let \(\hat{\mathbf{a}}^{k}_{t:t+H}\) denote the \(k\)-th predicted candidate action chunk, then \(\hat{\mathbf{a}}^{*}_{t:t+H}\) is the one with the smallest \(L_{1}\) distance to the ground truth \(\mathbf{a}_{t:t+H}\). \(\hat{s}_{k}\) is the predicted score for the \(k\)-th candidate, and its regression target \(s_{k}\) is defined as \(s_{k}=||\hat{\mathbf{a}}^{k}_{t:t+H}-\mathbf{a}_{t:t+H}||_{1}\). That is, the \(L_{1}\) distances between the \(K\) predicted action chunks and the ground-truth action chunk serve as the target labels for score prediction.
items.zh: 令\(\hat{\mathbf{a}}^{k}_{t:t+H}\)表示第\(k\)个预测候选动作块，则\(\hat{\mathbf{a}}^{*}_{t:t+H}\)是距离真实值\(\mathbf{a}_{t:t+H}\)具有最小\(L_{1}\)距离的那个。\(\hat{s}_{k}\)是第\(k\)个候选的预测分数，其回归目标\(s_{k}\)定义为\(s_{k}=||\hat{\mathbf{a}}^{k}_{t:t+H}-\mathbf{a}_{t:t+H}||_{1}\)。也就是说，\(K\)个预测动作块与真实动作块之间的\(L_{1}\)距离作为分数预测的目标标签。

items.en: Applying action-generation supervision directly on the VLM steers its representations toward features that better support action generation, thereby making the DiT learning more effective. However, we empirically observe that letting the DiT tokens attend to the KV cache of these action-related tokens degrades performance. We hypothesize that this arises from a shortcut in which the DiT simply copies the actions generated by the VLM rather than effectively grounding its own generation in the visual and textual context. To mitigate this issue, we exclude these action-related tokens from the DiT's attention computation, constraining the DiT tokens to attend solely to the representations of the language instruction and visual observations.
items.zh: 直接对 VLM 应用动作生成监督，会将其表示引导至更有利于动作生成的特征，从而使 DiT 学习更有效。然而，我们通过实验观察到，如果让 DiT 词元关注这些动作相关词元的 KV 缓存，性能反而会下降。我们假设这是由于一种捷径：DiT 仅仅是复制 VLM 生成的动作，而没有有效地将自己的生成基于视觉和文本上下文。为解决这一问题，我们将这些动作相关词元从 DiT 的注意力计算中排除，限制 DiT 词元仅关注语言指令和视觉观测的表示。

items.capEn: Figure 3: Pre-training Dataset. The pre-training dataset of Xiaomi-Robotics-1 contains over 100k hours of real-world manipulation trajectories collected with UMI devices.

items.en: During pre-training, our primary objective is to endow the model with broad and generalizable representations that transfer across diverse manipulation scenarios. To this end, we curate a dataset of over 100,000 hours of real-world manipulation trajectories, captured with Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) handheld grippers and egocentric cameras (Fig. 3). The dataset spans a diverse array of tasks collected across a massive scale of environments, including households, commercial premises, industrial sites, offices, and outdoor spaces. Traditional robot trajectory annotation requires manually segmenting trajectories according to task semantics and labeling each segment with a language instruction—a labor-intensive process that becomes prohibitive at this scale.
items.zh: 预训练期间，我们的主要目标是赋予模型广泛且可泛化的表示，这些表示能够迁移到多样的操作场景。为此，我们整理了一个超过10万小时的真实世界操作轨迹数据集，使用通用操作接口（UMI）手持夹爪和第一视角相机采集（图3）。数据集涵盖了大量环境中采集的多样化任务，包括家庭、商业场所、工业场地、办公室和户外空间。传统的机器人轨迹标注需要根据任务语义手动分割轨迹，并为每个片段标注语言指令——这是一个劳动密集型过程，在此规模下变得不可行。

items.en: To scale language annotation, we develop an auto-labeling pipeline that first divides each trajectory into equal-length segments and leverages Qwen3.5-27B to caption the state transitions of both the grippers and the interacting objects in the scene within each segment (see Fig. 11 for examples). To accelerate the annotation process, we develop a producer–consumer pipeline that decouples clip segmentations from caption labeling: while CPU worker threads cut per-segment clips into an in-memory filesystem, client threads keep hundreds of captioning requests in flight. This highly efficient pipeline allows us to label the entire corpus of over 100k hours in roughly two weeks. Trained on this dataset, the model learns to generate actions that drive the scene from the state in the current observation to the target state described by the language annotation.
items.zh: 为了规模化语言标注，我们开发了一个自动标注流水线，首先将每条轨迹分割成等长片段，并利用Qwen3.5-27B对每个片段中夹爪和场景中交互物体的状态转换进行描述（示例见图11）。为了加速标注过程，我们开发了一个生产者-消费者流水线，将片段分割与字幕标注解耦：CPU工作线程将每段片段剪入内存文件系统，同时客户端线程保持数百个标注请求持续进行。这个高效流水线使我们能够在约两周内标注整个超过10万小时的数据集。在该数据集上训练后，模型学会生成动作，驱动场景从当前观测状态转变为语言描述的目标状态。

items.en: The model is optimized to predict actions by jointly minimizing the flow-matching loss \(L_{\textrm{Flow}}\) of the DiT and the regression loss \(L_{\textrm{Regression}}\) of the VLM choice policy. To preserve the vision-language capabilities of the pre-trained VLM, we further co-train the model on a high-quality vision-language dataset curated in our previous work under the next-token prediction objective \(L_{\textrm{NTP}}\). The overall training objective is formulated as: where \(\lambda\) is set to \(0.1\) in our experiments. Vision-language data and UMI trajectories are sampled at a ratio of \(1{:}9\). To maximize training throughput, we pack all vision-language tokens within a batch into a single sequence for a VLM forward pass. Since the VLM is computationally more expensive than the DiT, we amortize its cost by sampling four flow-matching timesteps per sample. The resulting four DiT inputs are similarly packed and processed in one DiT pass, conditioned on the corresponding unpacked VLM KV cache.
items.zh: 模型通过联合最小化DiT的流匹配损失\(L_{\textrm{Flow}}\)和VLM选择策略的回归损失\(L_{\textrm{Regression}}\)来优化预测动作。为了保持预训练VLM的视觉-语言能力，我们还在之前工作中整理的高质量视觉-语言数据集上，以下一个词预测目标\(L_{\textrm{NTP}}\)共同训练模型。整体训练目标公式化为：其中在我们的实验中\(\lambda\)设置为\(0.1\)。视觉-语言数据和UMI轨迹以\(1{:}9\)的比例采样。为了最大化训练吞吐量，我们将一个批次内的所有视觉-语言词元打包成一个序列，用于VLM前向传播。由于VLM在计算上比DiT更昂贵，我们通过对每个样本采样四个流匹配时间步来分摊其成本。同样地，将得到的四个DiT输入打包并一次性通过DiT处理，并基于相应的解包VLM KV缓存进行条件化。

items.en: During pre-training, our primary objective is to endow the model with broad and generalizable representations that transfer across diverse manipulation scenarios. To this end, we curate a dataset of over 100,000 hours of real-world manipulation trajectories, captured with Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) handheld grippers and egocentric cameras (Fig. 3). The dataset spans a diverse array of tasks collected across a massive scale of environments, including households, commercial premises, industrial sites, offices, and outdoor spaces. Traditional robot trajectory annotation requires manually segmenting trajectories according to task semantics and labeling each segment with a language instruction—a labor-intensive process that becomes prohibitive at this scale.

items.capEn: Figure 4: Post-training Dataset. The post-training dataset of Xiaomi-Robotics-1 comprises about 10k hours of cross-embodiment trajectories, including over 7.2k hours of in-house robot data collected with mobile manipulators and dual-arm robots, over 1k hours of instruction-labeled UMI data, and open

items.en: The goal of post-training is twofold. First, we transfer the action-generation capabilities of UMI grippers acquired during pre-training to robot embodiments. Second, we shift the language conditioning from the state-transition descriptions used in pre-training to the imperative instructions humans typically issue when prompting robots to perform tasks.
items.zh: 后训练的目标有两个。首先，我们将预训练阶段获取的UMI夹爪的动作生成能力迁移至机器人具身形态。其次，我们将语言条件从预训练中使用的状态转移描述转向人类通常用于指示机器人执行任务的命令式指令。

items.en: We curate the post-training dataset with cross-embodiment manipulation trajectories collected using UMI devices, static robot arms, and mobile manipulators. Specifically, we collect over 7,200 hours of robot data using mobile manipulators and dual-arm robots across a diverse range of household environments and tasks (Fig. 4). We leverage Qwen3.5 to annotate human-segmented video clips with language instructions. In addition, we incorporate over 1,000 hours of human-annotated UMI data labeled with both temporal segments and language instructions. Unlike the state-transition descriptions used in pre-training, these language instructions closely mirror how humans prompt robots to perform tasks, directly matching our alignment objective in the post-training phase (see Fig. 11 and 12 for comparison). Finally, we include open-source robot datasets, including Bridge V2 , RT-1 , and DROID . We filter out idle segments within trajectories to prevent the model from learning uninformative or noisy signals. In total, our post-training dataset comprises about 10,000 hours of trajectory data.
items.zh: 我们利用UMI设备、静态机械臂和移动操作器收集的跨具身操作轨迹来策划后训练数据集。具体而言，我们使用移动操作器和双臂机器人在多样化的家庭环境和任务中收集了超过7,200小时的机器人数据（图4）。我们利用Qwen3.5为人工分割的视频片段标注语言指令。此外，我们还纳入了超过1,000小时的人工标注UMI数据，这些数据同时标注了时间片段和语言指令。与预训练中使用的状态转移描述不同，这些语言指令紧密反映了人类如何指示机器人执行任务，直接匹配我们在后训练阶段的对齐目标（对比见图11和图12）。最后，我们加入了开源机器人数据集，包括Bridge V2、RT-1和DROID。我们过滤掉轨迹中的空闲片段，以防止模型学习无信息或噪声信号。总体上，我们的后训练数据集包含约10,000小时的轨迹数据。

items.en: For arm actions, we adopt relative delta end-effector (EE) poses with respect to the current state:
items.zh: 对于手臂动作，我们采用相对于当前状态的末端执行器（EE）增量位姿：

items.en: where \(\prescript{\textrm{EE}}{\textrm{Base}}{T}_{t}\) denotes the pose of the end-effector with respect to the base at the current timestep \(t\), and \(\prescript{\textrm{EE}}{\textrm{Base}}{\hat{T}}_{t+i}\) represents the target end-effector pose at timestep \(t+i\). To align the arm action spaces across different embodiments, we unify the orientation of the end-effector frames across all robot data and UMI data in both the pre-training and post-training datasets. Consequently, similar arm motions (e.g., moving forward or backward with respect to the end-effector frame) yield consistent action values regardless of the underlying hardware platform. For mobile robot data, we represent the base and waist actions using the base velocity and the relative delta of the waist position, respectively. To accommodate heterogeneous embodiments, we adopt a unified action vector for all trajectory data. Although the arm actions are aligned across embodiments, the action spaces of different robots still differ in dimensionality. We mask out the dimensions corresponding to missing action components during loss computation.
items.zh: 其中 \(\prescript{\textrm{EE}}{\textrm{Base}}{T}_{t}\) 表示当前时间步 \(t\) 下末端执行器相对于基座的位姿，\(\prescript{\textrm{EE}}{\textrm{Base}}{\hat{T}}_{t+i}\) 表示时间步 \(t+i\) 下的目标末端执行器位姿。为了对齐不同具身形态的手臂动作空间，我们在预训练和后训练数据集中统一了所有机器人数据和UMI数据的末端执行器坐标系朝向。因此，类似的手臂运动（例如，相对于末端执行器坐标系向前或向后移动）会产生一致的动作值，无论底层硬件平台如何。对于移动机器人数据，我们分别使用基座速度和腰部位置的相对增量来表示基座和腰部动作。为了适应异质具身形态，我们为所有轨迹数据采用统一的动作向量。尽管手臂动作在不同具身形态间已对齐，但不同机器人的动作空间在维度上仍然不同。在损失计算过程中，我们屏蔽掉缺失动作分量对应的维度。

items.en: We train the model with the same objective as in pre-training (Eq. 1). Vision-language data, open-source robot data, instruction-labeled UMI data, and our in-house robot data are sampled at a ratio of \(0.5:0.5:0.5:8.5\). After post-training, the model can be prompted with language instructions to perform a wide range of tasks in unseen environments out-of-the-box. In addition, it can efficiently adapt to novel downstream tasks with minimal amount of data.
items.zh: 我们使用与预训练相同的目标训练模型（公式1）。视觉-语言数据、开源机器人数据、指令标注的UMI数据和自研机器人数据按 \(0.5:0.5:0.5:8.5\) 的比例采样。后训练后，模型可通过语言指令直接提示，在未见环境中执行广泛的任务，无需额外配置。此外，它还能以极少的数据高效适应新颖的下游任务。

items.capEn: Figure 5: Scaling of Pre-training. We show the validation action errors (MSE) from the data-scaling and model-scaling pre-training experiments. We terminate the training for 12.5% and 25% data in the data-scaling experiment early as the validation loss indicates overfitting.

Figure 6: Qualitative Results of Pre-training. After pre-training, Xiaomi-Robotics-1 is able to predict action trajectories for UMI grippers on a held-out validation set according to the language description of state transitions.

items.en: We design Xiaomi-Robotics-1 with scaling in mind. In this section, we investigate its scaling properties through extensive experiments. Specifically, we design experiments to answer the following questions:
items.zh: 我们设计 Xiaomi-Robotics-1 时考虑了 Scaling（规模扩张）。在本节中，我们通过大量实验研究其 Scaling 性质。具体而言，我们设计实验来回答以下问题：

items.en: Does Xiaomi-Robotics-1 scale effectively with increasing data scale and model size during pre-training?
items.zh: 在预训练过程中，Xiaomi-Robotics-1 是否能随着数据规模（data scale）和模型大小的增加而有效扩展？

items.en: Does a stronger pre-trained model translate to better post-training performance when evaluated out-of-the-box in novel environments?
items.zh: 更强的预训练模型是否能在新环境中以开箱即用（out-of-the-box）的方式评估时，转化为更好的后训练性能？

items.en: Can Xiaomi-Robotics-1 adapt to challenging new tasks with a minimal amount of data?
items.zh: Xiaomi-Robotics-1 能否以最少的数据量适应具有挑战性的新任务？

items.en: How does Xiaomi-Robotics-1 compare to other robot foundation models in real-robot experiments and simulation benchmarks?
items.zh: Xiaomi-Robotics-1 在实际机器人实验和仿真基准测试中与其他机器人基础模型（robot foundation models）相比如何？

items.en: We perform data-scaling experiments with Xiaomi-Robotics-1-5B. Due to compute budget limit, we pre-train the model on 12.5%, 25%, 50%, and 100% of about 20k hours of UMI data, respectively. Each model is evaluated on a held-out validation set. We use the mean-squared error (MSE) between the action predicted by flow-matching and the ground truth as the evaluation metric. As shown in Fig. 5, Xiaomi-Robotics-1 attains lower validation action errors with the increase of data scale. With 12.5% and 25% of data, the validation action errors first decrease and then increase during training, indicating overfitting. In contrast, the 50% and 100% data settings yield a monotonic decrease in loss, with the 20k setting exhibiting a steeper descent. We show qualitative results of action prediction on validation data in Fig. 6.
items.zh: 我们使用Xiaomi-Robotics-1-5B进行了数据Scaling实验。由于算力预算限制，我们分别在约2万小时UMI数据的12.5%、25%、50%和100%上预训练模型。每个模型在保留验证集上评估。我们采用流匹配预测的动作与真实值之间的均方误差（MSE）作为评估指标。如图5所示，随着数据规模增加，Xiaomi-Robotics-1的验证动作误差降低。使用12.5%和25%数据时，验证动作误差在训练中先下降后上升，表明过拟合。相比之下，50%和100%数据设置下损失单调递减，其中2万小时设置下降更陡。我们在图6中展示了验证数据上动作预测的定性结果。

items.en: We perform model-scaling experiments on three size variants of Xiaomi-Robotics-1 (2B, 5B, and 10B) as specified in Tab. 1. All three models are trained on the same 20k hours of data as in the data-scaling experiments and then evaluated on the same held-out validation set. As illustrated in Fig. 5, Xiaomi-Robotics-1 exhibits consistent improvements in action prediction precision as the model size scales up. However, the performance gap among different model sizes are less pronounced than those observed across different data scales. This result suggests that model capacity at the billions-parameter scale may already be sufficient to capture the current dataset’s distribution, thereby making data volume the primary bottleneck for further generalization. These findings do not diminish the value of model scaling, but rather highlight the critical importance of prioritizing the collection of large-scale, diverse datasets to unlock further performance gains.
items.zh: 我们对Xiaomi-Robotics-1的三种规模变体（2B、5B和10B）进行了模型Scaling实验，具体见表1。所有三个模型在数据Scaling实验中相同的2万小时数据上训练，然后在相同的保留验证集上评估。如图5所示，随着模型规模增大，Xiaomi-Robotics-1的动作预测精度持续提升。然而，不同模型规模之间的性能差距不如不同数据规模之间的差距显著。这一结果表明，数十亿参数规模的模型容量可能已足以捕捉当前数据集的分布，从而使得数据量成为进一步泛化的主要瓶颈。这些发现并未否定模型Scaling的价值，而是突显了优先收集大规模、多样化数据集以解锁进一步性能提升的关键重要性。

full.sec: 3.2 Post-training: Out-of-the-Box Evaluation in Novel Environments
full.secZh: 3.2 后训练：新环境中的开箱评估

items.en: In this section, we perform post-training experiments on the cross-embodiment post-training dataset and study its out-of-the-box performance in novel environments that are unseen during training. In particular, we are interested in understanding whether the data scaling and model scaling properties from pre-training can transfer to post-training. To mitigate overfitting, for the in-house robot data, we sample a diverse subset from the whole dataset for post-training. Models are evaluated out-of-the-box in unseen environments after post-training without any per-task or per-environment fine-tuning. Specifically, we evaluate on 4 tasks (Fig. 7), i.e., shoe storage, bag packing, table organization, sofa tidying. These tasks are seen in the post-training dataset but the environments and object instances during evaluation are unseen.
items.zh: 在本节中，我们在跨具身后训练数据集上进行后训练实验，并研究其在训练中未见的新环境中的开箱性能。我们特别关注预训练中的数据缩放和模型缩放特性是否可以迁移到后训练中。为了缓解过拟合，对于内部机器人数据，我们从整个数据集中采样一个多样化的子集用于后训练。模型在后训练后直接在新环境中进行评估，无需任何每任务或每环境的微调。具体来说，我们在4个任务（图7）上进行评估，即鞋子存放、背包打包、桌面整理、沙发整理。这些任务在后训练数据集中出现过，但评估时的环境和物体实例是未见过的。

full.secZh: 3.2.1 扩展预训练数据的有效性

items.en: We first examine whether the benefits of scaling pre-training data transfer to post-training with the 5B variant of Xiaomi-Robotics-1. Using an identical training recipe, we post-train models initialized from checkpoints pre-trained on 12.5%, 25%, 50%, and 100% of 20k pre-training data (Sec. 3.1), alongside a baseline initialized from the Qwen3-VL pre-trained weight without any action pre-training. Out-of-the-box evaluation results are shown in Fig. 8. The overall success rate increases monotonically with the scale of pre-training data, rising from 26% without action pre-training to 75% with 100% of pre-training data. The gains from scaling pre-training data are particularly pronounced on tasks that demand contact-rich manipulation. For instance, the baseline without pre-training fails completely on shoe tidying, whereas the model pre-trained on 100% of the data reaches a 75% success rate. Notably, utilizing only 12.5% of the pre-training data more than doubles the baseline’s overall success rate (26% vs. 53%). While the marginal gains gradually moderate as the pre-training corpus grows, the performance shows no sign of saturation: doubling the data from 50% to 100% yields an additional 6 percentage point improvement. These findings suggest that further scaling robot pre-training data remains a highly promising avenue for achieving stronger out-of-the-box performance in unseen environments.
items.zh: 我们首先检验扩展预训练数据的收益是否能迁移到后训练中，使用小米机器人1号的5B变体。采用相同的训练方案，我们对从在20k预训练数据的12.5%、25%、50%和100%上预训练的检查点初始化的模型进行后训练（第3.1节），同时还有一个从Qwen3-VL预训练权重初始化、没有任何动作预训练的基线。开箱评估结果如图8所示。总体成功率随预训练数据规模单调递增，从无动作预训练的26%提升到使用100%预训练数据的75%。扩展预训练数据带来的增益在需要密集接触操作的任务上尤为显著。例如，没有预训练的基线在整理鞋子任务上完全失败，而使用100%数据预训练的模型达到了75%的成功率。值得注意的是，仅使用12.5%的预训练数据就使基线的总体成功率翻倍有余（26%对比53%）。虽然边际收益随着预训练语料增长逐渐减弱，但性能并未显示出饱和迹象：将数据量从50%翻倍到100%额外带来了6个百分点的提升。这些发现表明，进一步扩展机器人预训练数据仍然是实现更强开箱性能的极具前景的途径，尤其是在未见环境中。

items.capEn: Figure 8: Quantitative Results of Post-training. We showcase the success rates of post-trained models across different pre-training data scales and model sizes.

full.secZh: 3.2.2 模型规模扩展的有效性

items.en: We further investigate the impact of model scale during post-training. Specifically, we post-train the three size variants of Xiaomi-Robotics-1 (2B, 5B, and 10B) specified in Tab. 1. These variants are initialized from checkpoints pre-trained on 20k hours of UMI pre-training data. As shown in Fig. 8, the overall success rate increases monotonically with model size, rising from 61% for the 2B variant to 75% and 79% for the 5B and 10B variants, respectively. Similar to data scaling, the gains from model scaling are most pronounced on shoe tidying, where the success rate climbs from 58% (2B) to 75% (5B) and further to 92% (10B). Performance improves consistently with model size across three out of four tasks, with the 5B and 10B variants performing comparably (80% and 77%) on sofa tidying. Combined with the results in Sec. 3.2.1, these findings suggest that pre-training data scale and model size constitute two complementary axes for improving out-of-the-box performance in out-of-distribution settings. And a stronger pre-trained model is able to translate to better out-of-the-box real-robot performance after post-training.
items.zh: 我们进一步研究了后训练期间模型规模的影响。具体来说，我们对表1中指定的Xiaomi-Robotics-1的三个规模变体（2B、5B和10B）进行了后训练。这些变体从在20k小时UMI预训练数据上预训练的检查点初始化。如图8所示，总体成功率随模型规模单调增加，从2B变体的61%上升到5B和10B变体的75%和79%。与数据规模扩展类似，模型规模扩展带来的收益在鞋子整理任务上最为显著，成功率从58%（2B）上升到75%（5B）并进一步达到92%（10B）。在四个任务中的三个任务上，性能随模型规模一致提升，5B和10B变体在沙发整理任务上表现相当（分别为80%和77%）。结合第3.2.1节的结果，这些发现表明预训练数据规模和模型规模构成了两个互补的维度，用于在分布外设置中提升开箱即用性能。并且更强的预训练模型能够在后训练后转化为更好的开箱即用真实机器人性能。

full.sec: 3.3 Downstream Fine-tuning: Efficient Adaptation to New Tasks
full.secZh: 3.3 下游微调：高效适应新任务

items.capEn: Figure 9: Downstream Fine-tuning Evaluation. We fine-tune the post-trained model on four new challenging tasks with a minimal amount of data.

items.en: A key desideratum of robot foundation models is their ability to efficiently adapt to novel tasks with minimal data. To investigate how Xiaomi-Robotics-1 performs in this setting, we fine-tune our post-trained model on a suite of four novel challenging tasks: phone packing, laundry loading, printer refilling, and box packing (Fig. 9). Crucially, these tasks are entirely held out from the in-house robot dataset. Each task introduces different complexities: phone packing requires bimanual coordination; laundry loading is a long-horizon mobile manipulation task involving multi-step instruction following; printer refilling demands handling of highly deformable sheets of paper; and box packing evaluates language grounding across multiple objects.
items.zh: 机器人基础模型的一个关键期望是能够用最少的数据高效适应新任务。为研究Xiaomi-Robotics-1在此情景下的表现，我们在四个新颖且具有挑战性的任务上对后训练模型进行了微调：手机包装、衣物装载、打印机加纸和盒子打包（图9）。关键的是，这些任务完全来自内部机器人数据集之外。每个任务引入了不同的复杂性：手机包装需要双手协调；衣物装载是一个长时程的移动操作任务，涉及多步指令跟随；打印机加纸要求处理高度可变形纸张；盒子打包则评估了跨多个对象的语言接地能力。

items.en: To evaluate data efficiency, we fine-tune the model under two settings. For the high-data setting, we leverage a total of 144 hours of data across all tasks. For the low-data setting, we sample 25% of the data for each task from the high-data setting, resulting in a subset of 36 hours in total. The average data per task for the low-data setting is less than 10 hours, with the maximum-data task, printer refilling, containing only 10.3 hours. This poses a significant challenge for policy learning. We fine-tune Xiaomi-Robotics-1 on the data of all four tasks using the asynchronous training recipe proposed in . We compare our method against two baselines: \(\pi_{0.5}\) and Xiaomi-Robotics-0 . For \(\pi_{0.5}\) , we follow the official OpenPi (https://github.com/Physical-Intelligence/openpi) fine-tuning protocol and fine-tune the base model on these tasks. For Xiaomi-Robotics-0 , we fine-tune its pre-trained model using the asynchronous setting. Each model is evaluated for 10 trials per task. We report both the average success rate and progress, where the progress measures partial task completion based on the task-specific milestones (Tab. 6). Results are shown in Fig. 10.
items.zh: 为评估数据效率，我们在两种设置下对模型进行微调。在高数据设置下，我们利用所有任务总共144小时的数据。在低数据设置下，我们从高数据设置中对每个任务采样25%的数据，得到总计36小时的子集。低数据设置下每个任务的平均数据量不足10小时，其中数据量最大的任务——打印机加纸——仅包含10.3小时。这对策略学习构成了重大挑战。我们使用文献[?]提出的异步训练方案，在所有四个任务的数据上微调Xiaomi-Robotics-1。我们将我们的方法与两个基线进行比较：\(\pi_{0.5}\)和Xiaomi-Robotics-0。对于\(\pi_{0.5}\)，我们遵循官方OpenPi (https://github.com/Physical-Intelligence/openpi) 微调协议，在这些任务上微调基础模型。对于Xiaomi-Robotics-0，我们使用异步设置微调其预训练模型。每个模型在每个任务上评估10次试验。我们报告平均成功率和进度，其中进度根据任务特定里程碑衡量部分任务完成情况（表6）。结果如图10所示。

items.en: Xiaomi-Robotics-1 outperforms the two baseline methods in terms of average success rates and progress in both low-data and high-data settings. In the low-data setting with less than 10 hours per task on average, it achieves an average success rate of 75% and an average progress of 90% across all four tasks, significantly outperforming \(\pi_{0.5}\) with a 40% success rate and a progress of 66%. The advantage of our method is most substantial on tasks requiring dexterous manipulation and mobile manipulation. In phone packing, Xiaomi-Robotics-1 outperforms both baseline methods substantially in the two data settings. In printer refilling, Xiaomi-Robotics-1 improves the success rate of the best baseline from 20% to 70% in the low-data setting, showcasing powerful capabilities in manipulating deformable objects. In laundry loading, our method shows strong robustness over the full task horizon where failure may occur at any stage, achieving an 80% success rate and a progress of 96% in the low-data setting. In this task, \(\pi_{0.5}\) struggles with opening the washing machine while Xiaomi-Robotics-0 fails to complete the task in the low-data setting. In box packing, all methods perform relatively well compared to other tasks, reaching 100% success rates when more task-specific data are available. Overall, all methods benefit from increasing the amount of fine-tuning data, but Xiaomi-Robotics-1 is substantially more data-efficient. We attribute this advantage to large-scale pre-training which exposes the model to diverse environments and tasks, and careful post-training alignment that aligns the strong manipulation capabilities acquired during pre-training to robot embodiments and instruction prompts. These results demonstrate that Xiaomi-Robotics-1 can serve as a strong foundation robot policy for efficient adaptation to novel tasks.
items.zh: Xiaomi-Robotics-1在低数据和高数据设置下，在平均成功率和进度方面均优于两种基线方法。在低数据设置下（每个任务平均不到10小时），它在所有四个任务上达到了75%的平均成功率和90%的平均进度，显著优于\(\pi_{0.5}\)（40%成功率和66%进度）。我们的方法在需要灵巧操作和移动操作的任务上优势最为显著。在手机包装中，Xiaomi-Robotics-1在两种数据设置下均大幅优于两种基线方法。在打印机加纸中，Xiaomi-Robotics-1将最佳基线的成功率从低数据设置下的20%提高到70%，展示了操作可变形物体的强大能力。在衣物装载中，我们的方法在整个任务跨度（故障可能在任何阶段发生）上表现出强鲁棒性，在低数据设置下达到了80%的成功率和96%的进度。在此任务中，\(\pi_{0.5}\)难以打开洗衣机，而Xiaomi-Robotics-0在低数据设置下未能完成任务。在盒子打包中，所有方法相较于其他任务都表现较好，当更多任务特定数据可用时均达到100%成功率。总体而言，所有方法都受益于微调数据量的增加，但Xiaomi-Robotics-1的数据效率显著更高。我们将这一优势归因于大规模预训练（使模型暴露于多样环境和任务）以及仔细的后训练对齐（将预训练中获得的操作能力与机器人实体和指令提示对齐）。这些结果表明，Xiaomi-Robotics-1可以作为强大的机器人基础策略，用于高效适应新任务。

items.en: In this section, we evaluate Xiaomi-Robotics-1 on four simulation benchmarks.
items.zh: 在本节中，我们在四个仿真基准测试上评估Xiaomi-Robotics-1。

items.en: RoboCasa: RoboCasa features single-arm manipulation in realistic kitchen environments. The benchmark contains 24 everyday kitchen manipulation tasks spanning pick-and-place, articulated-object interaction, appliance operation, and coffee-making. In order to test generalization capabilities, it evaluates policies on unseen object instances and includes two scenes of which the styles were unseen in the training data among the five evaluation scenes. For training, we use the official set of 300 synthetic demonstrations provided by the benchmark. Following the standard evaluation protocol, we report the average success rate over 100 evaluation episodes per task across the five evaluation scenes. Results are shown in Tab. 2.
items.zh: RoboCasa：RoboCasa 在逼真的厨房环境中进行单臂操作。该基准包含 24 个日常厨房操作任务，涵盖拾取与放置、铰接物体交互、电器操作和咖啡制作。为了测试泛化能力，它在未见过的物体实例上评估策略，并在五个评估场景中包含两个训练数据中未见过的风格场景。训练时，我们使用基准提供的官方 300 个合成演示。按照标准评估协议，我们报告每个任务在五个评估场景中 100 次评估情节的平均成功率。结果见表 2。

items.en: RoboCasa365: RoboCasa365 extends RoboCasa into a large-scale simulation benchmark for evaluating general-purpose robot manipulation, with a particular emphasis on generalization beyond the training task distribution. It expands the original 24-task benchmark to 365 tasks across over 2,500 procedurally generated kitchen scenes and 3,200 object instances, covering both short-horizon manipulation and long-horizon mobile manipulation. This diversity introduces substantial variations in kitchen layouts, object appearances, and spatial relationships, testing whether policies remain robust across unseen scene and object configurations rather than overfitting. More importantly, RoboCasa365 explicitly evaluates generalization on task composition via a split featuring task templates that are unseen during training. We train our policy using the officially released dataset, which provides 100 demonstrations for each task. We follow the standard evaluation protocol and evaluate across 50 benchmark tasks, comprising 18 seen atomic tasks, 16 seen composite tasks, and 16 unseen composite tasks. The unseen composite tasks provide a zero-shot evaluation of whether the policy can recombine previously learned atomic skills and semantic knowledge to solve novel long-horizon tasks. Results are shown in Tab. 3.
items.zh: RoboCasa365：RoboCasa365 将 RoboCasa 扩展为大规模仿真基准，用于评估通用机器人操作，特别强调超越训练任务分布的泛化。它将原始的 24 任务基准扩展到 365 个任务，涵盖 2500 多个程序生成的厨房场景和 3200 个物体实例，包括短视操作和长视移动操作。这种多样性引入了厨房布局、物体外观和空间关系的显著变化，测试策略是否在未见过的场景和物体配置下保持鲁棒性，而非过拟合。更重要的是，RoboCasa365 通过一个包含训练中未见任务模板的分割，明确评估任务组合的泛化能力。我们使用官方发布的数据集训练策略，每个任务提供 100 个演示。我们遵循标准评估协议，在 50 个基准任务上进行评估，包括 18 个已见原子任务、16 个已见复合任务和 16 个未见复合任务。未见复合任务提供了零样本评估，检验策略是否能重新组合先前学习的原子技能和语义知识来解决新颖的长视任务。结果见表 3。

items.en: VLABench: VLABench is a large-scale benchmark designed for comprehensive evaluation of language-conditioned manipulation. It comprises 100 task categories with over 2,000 object instances, emphasizing challenging scenarios involving semantic and distribution shifts. Specifically, VLABench introduces instructions with implicit human intentions, long-horizon tasks requiring multi-step reasoning, and evaluation settings that demand commonsense reasoning, category-level generalization, and robustness to unseen object appearances. These challenges are distributed across five evaluation tracks—In-distribution, Cross-Category, Commonsense, Instruction, and Texture—to thoroughly assess policy generalization. Beyond success rate (SR), VLABench introduces progress score (PS) and intention score (IS) to measure task completion quality and instruction understanding. Following the standard evaluation protocol, we train our policy using only the official training set from the In-distribution track, which contains 10 tasks with 500 demonstrations per task. We leverage chain-of-thought (CoT) labeling as in ERVLA and train our model with a 50% probability on the next-token-prediction loss of CoT alongside the action loss. During evaluation, each task is tested across all five tracks with 50 evaluation episodes per track, resulting in 250 rollouts for each task and 2,500 rollouts in total. Results are shown in Tab. 4.
items.zh: VLABench：VLABench 是一个大规模基准，旨在全面评估语言条件操作。它包含 100 个任务类别，超过 2000 个物体实例，重点强调涉及语义和分布偏移的挑战性场景。具体来说，VLABench 引入了带有隐含人类意图的指令、需要多步推理的长视任务，以及需要常识推理、类别级泛化以及对未见物体外观的鲁棒性的评估设置。这些挑战分布在五个评估轨道中——分布内、跨类别、常识、指令和纹理——以全面评估策略的泛化能力。除了成功率（SR），VLABench 还引入了进度分数（PS）和意图分数（IS）来衡量任务完成质量和指令理解。按照标准评估协议，我们仅使用来自分布内轨道的官方训练集训练策略，该训练集包含 10 个任务，每个任务 500 个演示。我们像 ERVLA 那样利用思维链（CoT）标注，并以 50% 的概率在 CoT 的下一词预测损失与动作损失一起训练模型。在评估中，每个任务在所有五个轨道上测试，每个轨道 50 次评估情节，每个任务共 250 次 rollout，总计 2500 次 rollout。结果见表 4。

items.en: RoboDojo: RoboDojo is a unified simulation and real-world benchmark for comprehensively evaluating generalist robot manipulation policies. Unlike existing benchmarks that focus primarily on individual skills, RoboDojo provides a diverse and challenging suite comprising over 42 simulation tasks with varied object configurations, scene layouts, and language objectives. These tasks are organized into five core capability dimensions: Generalization (robustness to object/layout changes), Precision (fine-grained control), Long-Horizon (multi-step execution), Memory (state-dependent manipulation), and Open (open-ended instruction following). Following the official protocol, we evaluate Xiaomi-Robotics-1 on the RoboDojo simulation benchmark and report the average score and success rate of each capability dimensions. Results are shown in Tab. 5.
items.zh: RoboDojo：RoboDojo 是一个统一的仿真和真实世界基准，用于全面评估通才机器人操作策略。与主要关注单一技能的现有基准不同，RoboDojo 提供了一个多样且具有挑战性的套件，包含超过 42 个仿真任务，具有不同的物体配置、场景布局和语言目标。这些任务组织为五个核心能力维度：泛化（对物体/布局变化的鲁棒性）、精度（细粒度控制）、长视（多步执行）、记忆（状态依赖操作）和开放（开放式指令跟随）。按照官方协议，我们在 RoboDojo 仿真基准上评估 Xiaomi-Robotics-1，并报告每个能力维度的平均分数和成功率。结果见表 5。

items.en: Xiaomi-Robotics-1 achieves state-of-the-art results across all the four challenging benchmarks. It achieves an average success rate of 74.5% in RoboCasa. In RoboCasa365, it significantly outperforms the previous best methods by 10.8 percentage points, obtaining an average success rate of 57.4%. Specifically, it delivers the largest improvement on the most challenging split of Composite-Unseen, showcasing powerful generalization capabilities to task compositions that were unseen during training. In VLABench, Xiaomi-Robotics-1 achieves the highest average success rate and progress score, while maintaining a competitive intention score. This highlights its strong robustness to semantic and distribution shifts as well as superior long-horizon reasoning and language-conditioned manipulation capabilities. Notably, under cross-category and texture shifts, Xiaomi-Robotics-1 surpasses the strongest baseline by 6.0 and 15.2 percentage points in terms of success rate, respectively, demonstrating effective generalization to unseen objects and high resilience to visual appearance and background perturbations. In RoboDojo, Xiaomi-Robotics-1 significantly outperforms existing baseline methods, achieving absolute improvements of 7% and 5.13% in terms of average score and average success rate, respectively, over the second-best method. It ranks first across four out of five dimensions, indicating the model’s outstanding overall performance across diverse task types. Notably, we do not incorporate history observation in the evaluation of the RoboDojo benchmark. Consequently, it scores lower on the memory dimension than Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA which explicitly models memory, yet it still significantly outperforms all other models.
items.zh: Xiaomi-Robotics-1 在所有四个具有挑战性的基准测试中均取得了最先进的结果。它在 RoboCasa 中实现了 74.5% 的平均成功率。在 RoboCasa365 中，它以 10.8 个百分点的优势显著超越了此前的最佳方法，获得了 57.4% 的平均成功率。具体来说，它在最难的数据划分 Composite-Unseen 上取得了最大的改进，展示了对训练中未见过的任务组合的强大泛化能力。在 VLABench 中，Xiaomi-Robotics-1 获得了最高的平均成功率和进度分数，同时保持了有竞争力的意图分数。这突显了其对语义和分布偏移的强鲁棒性，以及卓越的长期推理和语言条件操作能力。值得注意的是，在跨类别和纹理偏移下，Xiaomi-Robotics-1 的成功率分别比最强基线高出 6.0 和 15.2 个百分点，展示了对未见物体的有效泛化以及对视觉外观和背景扰动的高弹性。在 RoboDojo 中，Xiaomi-Robotics-1 显著优于现有的基线方法，在平均分数和平均成功率上分别比第二好的方法绝对提升了 7% 和 5.13%。它在五个维度中的四个上排名第一，表明该模型在不同任务类型上的卓越整体性能。值得注意的是，我们在 RoboDojo 基准测试的评估中没有纳入历史观察。因此，它在记忆维度上的得分低于显式建模记忆的 Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA，但仍然显著优于所有其他模型。

items.en: Research on the scaling laws of large language models (LLMs) demonstrates that performance improves predictably when data, compute, and model capacity are scaled in tandem. Recent advances in large language models and multi-modal foundation models further demonstrate substantial capability gains driven by scaling of data and model size. Motivated by these advancements, robot learning has increasingly embraced this scaling paradigm, enlarging both data and model sizes in pursuit of foundational generalist policies. Scaling robot learning, however, differs fundamentally from scaling models trained on web-scale data. Collecting real-robot trajectories requires costly and labor-intensive teleoperation, and the resulting data are often confined to a narrow slice of environments and tasks, severely constraining the data diversity. To alleviate this data bottleneck, recent work leverages portable UMI devices, enabling the collection of real-world manipulation trajectories without requiring physical robot embodiments. This lowers the barrier to data collection by facilitating in-the-wild collection across a highly diverse spectrum of unconstrained, real-world environments. Complementarily, another line of research leverages egocentric human manipulation trajectories to capture diverse behaviors across various tasks, objects, and environments, and subsequently converts them to robot data via representation alignment or motion retargeting. In this work, we leverage over 100k hours of real-world manipulation trajectories collected from UMI devices. By varying data scale and model size, we investigate the scaling behavior of our model during pre-training and whether scaling translates to real-robot performance after post-training.
items.zh: 关于大型语言模型（LLM）缩放定律的研究表明，当数据、算力和模型容量同步规模扩张时，性能会可预测地提升。大型语言模型和多模态基础模型的最新进展进一步证明了由数据和模型规模的规模扩张所带来的显著能力提升。受这些进展的推动，机器人学习越来越广泛地采用这一规模扩张范式，通过扩大数据和模型规模来追求基础的通才策略。然而，机器人学习的规模扩张与基于网络规模数据训练的模型规模扩张有根本不同。收集真实机器人轨迹需要昂贵且劳动密集型的遥操作，得到的数据往往局限于狭窄的环境和任务范围，严重限制了数据多样性。为了缓解这一数据瓶颈，最近的工作利用便携式UMI设备，使得无需物理机器人实体即可收集真实世界的操作轨迹。这降低了数据收集的门槛，促进了在高度多样、不受约束的真实世界环境中的野外收集。作为补充，另一条研究路线利用以自我为中心的人类操作轨迹来捕获跨各种任务、对象和环境的多样行为，随后通过表示对齐或运动重定向将其转换为机器人数据。在本工作中，我们利用了从UMI设备收集的超过10万小时的真实世界操作轨迹。通过变化数据规模和模型大小，我们研究了模型在预训练期间的缩放行为，以及规模扩张是否会在后训练后转化为真实的机器人性能。

items.en: Recently, robot foundation models have emerged as a new paradigm for generalizable robot learning. By leveraging large-scale datasets, these models enable robust generalization across diverse environments and facilitate efficient adaptation to novel downstream tasks. World-action models (WAMs) and vision-language-action (VLA) models represent two popular paradigms of robot foundation models. WAMs are generally built upon pre-trained video models. They explicitly model future observations or environment dynamics and use these predictions to facilitate action generation. Early approaches typically generate visual plans from language-specified goals and subsequently translate them into executable robot actions. More recent work extends this paradigm to several directions, including jointly modeling future prediction and action generation, incorporating explicit 3D geometric structure, and training on large-scale heterogeneous video-action data to improve zero-shot generalization and cross-embodiment transfer. In contrast, VLA models leverage pre-trained vision-language models as backbone, aiming to harness their rich, general semantic knowledge to facilitate robust action prediction. Recent advances improve VLA models along three main axes. First, reasoning-oriented methods introduce intermediate representations (e.g., embodied reasoning tokens and visual chains of thought) to support semantic, spatial, and temporal reasoning. Second, advances in action representation address the limitations of naive action discretization through learned tokenizers and flow matching. Third, large-scale pre-training across heterogeneous datasets with different robot embodiments enables strong cross-embodiment transfer and robust downstream performance. Our work follows the VLA paradigm but focuses on a complementary question: the scaling behavior of robot foundation models. To support this investigation, we develop a scalable infrastructure to curate massive trajectory datasets with precise language annotations. Leveraging this data for large-scale training, we conduct extensive experiments to systematically explore the scaling properties of foundational VLA models.
items.zh: 最近，机器人基础模型已成为可泛化机器人学习的新范式。通过利用大规模数据集，这些模型实现了跨多样环境的鲁棒泛化，并促进了高效适应新的下游任务。世界-动作模型（WAM）和视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型代表了机器人基础模型的两种流行范式。WAM通常建立在预训练的视频模型之上。它们显式地建模未来观测或环境动态，并利用这些预测来促进动作生成。早期的方法通常从语言指定的目标生成视觉计划，然后将其转化为可执行的机器人动作。更近期的研究将该范式扩展到多个方向，包括联合建模未来预测和动作生成、融入显式3D几何结构，以及在大规模异构视频-动作数据上训练以改进零样本泛化和跨实体迁移。相比之下，VLA模型利用预训练的视觉-语言模型作为骨干，旨在利用其丰富的一般语义知识来促进鲁棒的动作预测。最近的进展沿三个主要方向改进了VLA模型。第一，面向推理的方法引入中间表示（例如，具身推理token和视觉思维链）以支持语义、空间和时间推理。第二，动作表示的进展通过学习的分词器和流匹配解决了朴素动作离散化的局限性。第三，跨不同机器人实体的异构数据集的大规模预训练实现了强大的跨实体迁移和鲁棒的下游性能。我们的工作遵循VLA范式，但关注一个补充问题：机器人基础模型的缩放行为。为了支持这一研究，我们开发了一个可扩展的基础设施，以整理带有精确语言标注的大规模轨迹数据集。利用这些数据进行大规模训练，我们进行了大量实验，系统地探索了基础VLA模型的缩放特性。

items.en: In this work, we present Xiaomi-Robotics-1, a foundational vision-language-action (VLA) model that is able to follow instructions to perform a wide range of mobile manipulation tasks out-of-the-box in unseen environments, and efficiently adapt to novel challenging tasks with a minimal amount of data. During pre-training, we leverage over 100,000 hours of real-world manipulation trajectories, endowing the model with broad and generalizable manipulation capabilities. To scale training effectively, we propose an auto-labeling pipeline that annotates the large-scale dataset with detailed descriptions of scene state transitions as language prompts. In the post-training phase, we align these strong capabilities acquired during pre-training with robot embodiments and imperative instruction prompts using a cross-embodiment dataset. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the performance of Xiaomi-Robotics-1 consistently improves with increasing data scale and model size during pre-training. More importantly, the scaling property directly translates to out-of-the-box performance in unseen environments after post-training. Xiaomi-Robotics-1 can also serve as a powerful robot foundation model that is able to adapt to novel challenging real-robot tasks with minimal data. In addition, it achieves strong state-of-the-art results on four challenging simulation benchmarks. We hope this work can serve as a foundation for future exploration of scalable robot policies that can be deployed out-of-the-box in the real world.
items.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出了Xiaomi-Robotics-1，这是一个基础性的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，能够遵循指令在未见环境中开箱即用地执行广泛的移动操作任务，并且仅用极少的数据就能高效适应新的挑战性任务。在预训练阶段，我们利用了超过10万小时的真实世界操作轨迹，赋予模型广泛且可泛化的操作能力。为了有效扩展训练规模，我们提出了一种自动标注流水线，用场景状态转换的详细描述作为语言提示来注释大规模数据集。在后训练阶段，我们使用跨具身数据集将预训练阶段获得的这些强大能力与机器人具身及命令式指令提示进行对齐。大量实验表明，Xiaomi-Robotics-1的性能在预训练期间随着数据规模和模型大小的增加而持续提升。更重要的是，这种Scaling（规模扩张）特性直接转化为后训练后在未见环境中的开箱即用性能。Xiaomi-Robotics-1还可以作为强大的机器人基础模型，能够以最少的数据适应新的挑战性真实机器人任务。此外，它在四个具有挑战性的仿真基准上取得了强大的最先进结果。我们希望这项工作能够为未来探索可开箱即用于真实世界的可扩展机器人策略奠定基础。
